tour.title: Welcome to the AI Chat
tour.intro: We'll show you in a few steps how to use the Nexyflow chat.

steps.title: Write your message
steps.body: Type your social media question here. Ask for advice, analysis or growth strategies for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

steps.title: Use quick suggestions
steps.body: Not sure where to start? Tap one of these suggestions to send a ready-made question right away.

steps.title: Send the message
steps.body: Press the Send button (or Enter) to submit your question. While the AI is answering, you can stop it anytime.

steps.title: Your chat history
steps.body: Your conversations are saved here. Create new ones, resume them anytime or delete them.

steps.title: Your account
steps.body: Here you find your profile, active plan and settings. The chat only reads your data to give personalized answers, without ever performing actions.

help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions.

questions.whatIsNexyflowA: Nexyflow is an all-in-one platform that uses AI to analyze and optimize your presence on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
questions.howDoesAiWorkA: Connect your social profiles and our AI analyzes metrics like engagement, follower growth, content performance and trends.
questions.needTechnicalSkillsA: No! Nexyflow is designed to be intuitive. Just connect your profiles and let the AI do the work.
questions.supportedPlatformsA: We support Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. We're working on adding LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitter.
questions.freePlanLimitations: Does the free plan have limitations?
questions.freePlanLimitationsA: It includes up to 3 AI queries per day and basic analysis. For unlimited queries and advanced analysis, upgrade to Pro.
questions.dataSafetyA: We use end-to-end encryption, don't store your social credentials and don't share data with third parties.
questions.deleteAccountA: Yes, you can delete your account from settings. All data will be permanently deleted within 30 days.
questions.howToConnect: How do I connect my profiles?
questions.howToConnectA: Go to 'Connect Platforms' in your Dashboard. Select the platform and follow the guided procedure.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your data.
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your data.
privacy.section1Text: We collect registration data (name, email), social media data (public metrics from connected profiles) and platform usage data.
privacy.section2Text: We use data to provide AI analysis, improve the service, communicate updates and ensure platform security.
privacy.section3Text: We do not sell your personal data. We only share data with essential service providers under strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy.section4Text: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access.
privacy.section5Text: You have the right to access, correct or delete your data at any time from your account settings.
